   150	            f"battle={st.battle.kind} last_battle_result={driver.latch.result} "
   151	            f"party={len(st.party)} | joy_ignore=${st.joy_ignore:02X} "
   152	            f"walk_counter={st.walk_counter} text_box_id=${st.text_box_id:02X} "
   153	            f"font_loaded={st.font_loaded} tile_in_front=${st.tile_in_front:02X} "

   161	def battle_ready(state) -> bool:
   162	    """Whether wBattleMon and wEnemyMon hold a battle yet.
   163	
   164	    Both are zeroed through the encounter intro, and every menu byte lies about it, so a
   165	    branch taken on the flag alone asks about a level 0 MON_00 with no moves.
   166	    """
   167	    active, opponent = state.battle.active, state.battle.opponent
   168	    return bool(active and opponent and active.level and opponent.level)

   171	def classify(driver: Driver, goal, waypoint) -> tuple[str, object]:
   172	    """Code decides what kind of tick this is. Only two answers reach Jev.
   173	
   174	    Returns (action, payload): ("wait", None), ("press", button), or ("branch", Branch).
   175	    """
   176	    st = driver.state
   177	    if st.in_battle:
   178	        if not battle_ready(st):
   179	            # "BLUE wants to fight!" is on screen and wBattleMon is still zeroed. The
   180	            # menu bytes cannot say so: wMaxMenuItem keeps the name list's 3 forever and
   181	            # wFontLoaded is overworld-only, so battle text leaves it at 0. The structs
   182	            # being filled in is the one signal that means the menu is really up.
   183	            return _press(st, "a")
   184	        if st.joy_ignore & (S.PAD_A | S.PAD_CTRL_PAD):
   185	            return "wait", None  # the menu is up but the script still owns the pad
   186	        branch = options.battle_branch(
   187	            st, goal, items=options.bag(driver.emu.memory), turn=driver.turn
   188	        )
   189	        return "branch", branch
   190	    prompt = screen.yes_no_prompt(driver.emu.memory)
   191	    if prompt:
   192	        # a cursor is up and A would just take whatever it is sitting on, which said YES
   193	        # to "give a nickname?" and then mashed the keyboard into AAAAAAAAAAAA
   194	        return "branch", options.dialogue_branch(st, goal, prompt[0], prompt[1])

   196	        # a text box with no cursor: A costs nothing. wFontLoaded, not wTextBoxID: the
   197	        # latter holds the id of the last box drawn and never clears, so on a cartridge
   198	        # it reads 1 from the intro onward and the agent presses A forever
   199	        return _press(st, "a")

   201	    if step and not driver.blocked(step):
   202	        return _press(st, step)
   203	    if waypoint and step is None and driver.heading:
   204	        # standing on the waypoint. Stairs warp the moment they are stepped on, but a
   205	        # house door leaves the player on the mat and wants one more step through it,
   206	        # which is the direction that got us here.
   207	        return _press(st, driver.heading)
   208	    if step and route.distance(st, waypoint) == 1:
   209	        # the waypoint is the next tile and it will not be walked onto: it is an object,
   210	        # Oak or a poke ball. Walking into it already turned the player to face it.
   211	        return _press(st, "a")

   213	        d
   214	        for d in route.sidesteps(st, driver.collision(), waypoint)
   215	        if not driver.blocked(d)
   216	    ]
   217	    if len(free) == 1:
   218	        return _press(st, free[0])
   219	    if len(free) > 1:

   224	def _press(state, button: str) -> tuple[str, object]:
   225	    return ("press", button) if input_ready(state, button) else ("wait", None)

   228	def play(
   229	    emulator,
   230	    policy: Policy,
   231	    max_decisions: int,
   232	    log_path: Path | None = None,
   233	    on_decision=None,
   234	    max_ticks: int = 200_000,
   235	    on_frame=None,
   236	) -> list[dict]:
   237	    """Run until the goal stack empties or `max_decisions` Jev calls have happened."""
   238	    driver = Driver(emulator, on_frame=on_frame)
   239	    stack = goals.GoalStack()
   240	    records: list[dict] = []
   241	    log = log_path.open("a") if log_path else None
   242	    stale, on_goal, where = 0, None, None
   243	    try:
   244	        for _ in range(max_ticks):
   245	            if len(records) >= max_decisions or stack.done:
   246	                break
   247	            driver.tick()
   248	            stack.advance(driver.state, driver.latch)
   249	            goal = stack.current
   250	            if goal is None:
   251	                break
   252	            here = _progress(driver)
   253	            if goal is not on_goal or here != where:
   254	                stale = 0
   255	            on_goal, where = goal, here
   256	            waypoint = route.waypoint_for(goal, driver.state)
   257	            action, payload = classify(driver, goal, waypoint)
   258	            if action == "wait":
   259	                continue
   260	            if action == "press":
   261	                driver.press(payload)
   262	                continue
   263	            forced = stale >= NO_PROGRESS_CAP
   264	            decision = policy.decide(payload, forced=forced)
   265	            if payload.kind == "battle":
   266	                driver.turn += 1
   267	            # the row's HP is the HP the decision was taken on, not what the buttons then
   268	            # did to it: `measure` labels turn n from the HP row n+1 carries
   269	            asked_on = driver.state
   270	            for button in options.buttons_for(driver.state, payload, decision.option):
   271	                driver.press(button)
   272	            if payload.kind == "battle":
   273	                settle_turn(driver)
   274	            record = _record(goal, payload, decision, driver, asked_on)
   275	            records.append(record)
   276	            if log:
   277	                log.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
   278	                log.flush()
   279	            if on_decision:
   280	                on_decision(record)
   281	            stale += 1
   282	    finally:
   283	        if log:
   284	            log.close()
   285	    return records

   288	def _battle_signature(state) -> tuple:
   289	    active, opponent = state.battle.active, state.battle.opponent
   290	    return (
   291	        state.in_battle,
   292	        active.hp if active else None,
   293	        opponent.hp if opponent else None,
   294	        state.active_slot,
   295	    )

   298	def settle_turn(driver: Driver):
   299	    """Advance until the chosen move has actually resolved.
   300	
   301	    The battle menu is back up long before the turn is over, and every byte that could
   302	    say otherwise is stale, so without this the same unchanged turn is asked again on the
   303	    next tick: one rival battle billed 139 decisions, eight of them identical at full HP.
   304	    """
   305	    before = _battle_signature(driver.state)
   306	    for _ in range(TURN_SETTLE_TICKS):
   307	        driver.tick()
   308	        if _battle_signature(driver.state) != before:
   309	            return
   310	        if input_ready(driver.state, "a"):
   311	            driver.press("a")  # damage text, level ups, whatever is between turns
   312

   314	def _progress(driver: Driver) -> tuple:
   315	    """What "getting somewhere" means, for the no-progress cap.
   316	
   317	    A tile, a finished battle, or a dent in the opponent. A long battle that is being won
   318	    is not stuck, and the cap should not fire on it.
   319	    """
   320	    st = driver.state
   321	    foe = st.battle.opponent
   322	    return (st.map_id, st.x, st.y, driver.latch.count, foe.hp if foe else None)

   325	def _record(goal, branch: Branch, decision: Decision, driver: Driver, st) -> dict:
   326	    return {
   327	        "t": time.time(),
   328	        "goal": goal.name,
   329	        "battle_index": driver.latch.count,

   331	        "state": branch.state,
   332	        "options": branch.options,
   333	        "choice": decision.option,
   334	        "probabilities": decision.probabilities,
   335	        "nouls": decision.nouls,
   336	        "fell_back": decision.fell_back,
   337	        "latency_ms": decision.latency_ms,
   338	        "input_tokens": decision.input_tokens,
   339	        "active_hp_fraction": st.battle.active.hp_fraction
   340	        if st.battle.active
   341	        else None,
   342	        # the party slot that was judged. A fainted mon never gets another decision of
   343	        # its own, so the faint shows up as the next decision being a different slot.
   344	        "active_slot": st.active_slot if st.battle.active else None,
   345	    }

   161	def battle_ready(state) -> bool:

   163

   165	    branch taken on the flag alone asks about a level 0 MON_00 with no moves.

   171	def classify(driver: Driver, goal, waypoint) -> tuple[str, object]:
   172	    """Code decides what kind of tick this is. Only two answers reach Jev.
   173	
   174	    Returns (action, payload): ("wait", None), ("press", button), or ("branch", Branch).
   175	    """
   176	    st = driver.state
   177	    if st.in_battle:
   178	        if not battle_ready(st):
   179	            # "BLUE wants to fight!" is on screen and wBattleMon is still zeroed. The
   180	            # menu bytes cannot say so: wMaxMenuItem keeps the name list's 3 forever and
   181	            # wFontLoaded is overworld-only, so battle text leaves it at 0. The structs
   182	            # being filled in is the one signal that means the menu is really up.
   183	            return _press(st, "a")
   184	        if st.joy_ignore & (S.PAD_A | S.PAD_CTRL_PAD):
   185	            return "wait", None  # the menu is up but the script still owns the pad
   186	        branch = options.battle_branch(
   187	            st, goal, items=options.bag(driver.emu.memory), turn=driver.turn
   188	        )
   189	        return "branch", branch
   190	    prompt = screen.yes_no_prompt(driver.emu.memory)
   191	    if prompt:
   192	        # a cursor is up and A would just take whatever it is sitting on, which said YES
   193	        # to "give a nickname?" and then mashed the keyboard into AAAAAAAAAAAA
   194	        return "branch", options.dialogue_branch(st, goal, prompt[0], prompt[1])

   197	        # latter holds the id of the last box drawn and never clears, so on a cartridge
   198	        # it reads 1 from the intro onward and the agent presses A forever
   199	        return _press(st, "a")

   201	    if step and not driver.blocked(step):
   202	        return _press(st, step)
   203	    if waypoint and step is None and driver.heading:

   205	        # house door leaves the player on the mat and wants one more step through it,
   206	        # which is the direction that got us here.
   207	        return _press(st, driver.heading)
   208	    if step and route.distance(st, waypoint) == 1:
   209	        # the waypoint is the next tile and it will not be walked onto: it is an object,
   210	        # Oak or a poke ball. Walking into it already turned the player to face it.
   211	        return _press(st, "a")

   213	        d
   214	        for d in route.sidesteps(st, driver.collision(), waypoint)
   215	        if not driver.blocked(d)
   216	    ]
   217	    if len(free) == 1:

   219	    if len(free) > 1:

   228	def play(
   229	    emulator,
   230	    policy: Policy,
   231	    max_decisions: int,
   232	    log_path: Path | None = None,
   233	    on_decision=None,
   234	    max_ticks: int = 200_000,
   235	    on_frame=None,
   236	) -> list[dict]:
   237	    """Run until the goal stack empties or `max_decisions` Jev calls have happened."""
   238	    driver = Driver(emulator, on_frame=on_frame)
   239	    stack = goals.GoalStack()
   240	    records: list[dict] = []
   241	    log = log_path.open("a") if log_path else None
   242	    stale, on_goal, where = 0, None, None
   243	    try:
   244	        for _ in range(max_ticks):
   245	            if len(records) >= max_decisions or stack.done:
   246	                break
   247	            driver.tick()
   248	            stack.advance(driver.state, driver.latch)
   249	            goal = stack.current
   250	            if goal is None:
   251	                break
   252	            here = _progress(driver)
   253	            if goal is not on_goal or here != where:
   254	                stale = 0
   255	            on_goal, where = goal, here
   256	            waypoint = route.waypoint_for(goal, driver.state)
   257	            action, payload = classify(driver, goal, waypoint)
   258	            if action == "wait":
   259	                continue
   260	            if action == "press":
   261	                driver.press(payload)
   262	                continue
   263	            forced = stale >= NO_PROGRESS_CAP
   264	            decision = policy.decide(payload, forced=forced)
   265	            if payload.kind == "battle":
   266	                driver.turn += 1
   267	            # the row's HP is the HP the decision was taken on, not what the buttons then
   268	            # did to it: `measure` labels turn n from the HP row n+1 carries
   269	            asked_on = driver.state
   270	            for button in options.buttons_for(driver.state, payload, decision.option):
   271	                driver.press(button)
   272	            if payload.kind == "battle":
   273	                settle_turn(driver)
   274	            record = _record(goal, payload, decision, driver, asked_on)
   275	            records.append(record)
   276	            if log:
   277	                log.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
   278	                log.flush()
   279	            if on_decision:
   280	                on_decision(record)
   281	            stale += 1
   282	    finally:
   283	        if log:
   284	            log.close()
   285	    return records

   288	def _battle_signature(state) -> tuple:
   289	    active, opponent = state.battle.active, state.battle.opponent
   290	    return (
   291	        state.in_battle,
   292	        active.hp if active else None,
   293	        opponent.hp if opponent else None,
   294	        state.active_slot,
   295	    )

   298	def settle_turn(driver: Driver):
   299	    """Advance until the chosen move has actually resolved.
   300	
   301	    The battle menu is back up long before the turn is over, and every byte that could
   302	    say otherwise is stale, so without this the same unchanged turn is asked again on the
   303	    next tick: one rival battle billed 139 decisions, eight of them identical at full HP.
   304	    """
   305	    before = _battle_signature(driver.state)
   306	    for _ in range(TURN_SETTLE_TICKS):
   307	        driver.tick()
   308	        if _battle_signature(driver.state) != before:
   309	            return
   310	        if input_ready(driver.state, "a"):
   311	            driver.press("a")  # damage text, level ups, whatever is between turns
   312

   314	def _progress(driver: Driver) -> tuple:
   315	    """What "getting somewhere" means, for the no-progress cap.
   316	
   317	    A tile, a finished battle, or a dent in the opponent. A long battle that is being won
   318	    is not stuck, and the cap should not fire on it.
   319	    """
   320	    st = driver.state
   321	    foe = st.battle.opponent
   322	    return (st.map_id, st.x, st.y, driver.latch.count, foe.hp if foe else None)

   325	def _record(goal, branch: Branch, decision: Decision, driver: Driver, st) -> dict:
   326	    return {
   327	        "t": time.time(),
   328	        "goal": goal.name,
   329	        "battle_index": driver.latch.count,
   330	        "kind": branch.kind,
   331	        "state": branch.state,
   332	        "options": branch.options,
   333	        "choice": decision.option,
   334	        "probabilities": decision.probabilities,
   335	        "nouls": decision.nouls,
   336	        "fell_back": decision.fell_back,
   337	        "latency_ms": decision.latency_ms,
   338	        "input_tokens": decision.input_tokens,
   339	        "active_hp_fraction": st.battle.active.hp_fraction

   342	        # the party slot that was judged. A fainted mon never gets another decision of

    25	def input_ready(state, button: str) -> bool:
    26	    """Whether the game will honour *this* button this tick.
    27	
    28	    Per button, because `wJoyIgnore` is a mask and not a flag: `_Joypad`
    29	    (engine/joypad.asm) ANDs its complement into the held and pressed bytes, and scripted
    30	    dialogue sets `PAD_SELECT | PAD_START | PAD_CTRL_PAD` precisely so that A still
    31	    advances the text while walking is locked out. Waiting for the whole byte to clear
    32	    deadlocks: the script is waiting for the A press, and the agent is waiting for the
    33	    script. `wWalkCounter` is nonzero mid-step, which only blocks another step.
    34	
    35	    Still to settle on a cartridge with `jpp probe --rom <path>`: whether any other byte
    36	    has to be in the predicate. The mask semantics are not a guess.
    37	    """
    38	    if state.joy_ignore & S.BUTTON_BITS.get(button, 0):
    39	        return False
    40	    return button in ("a", "b") or state.walk_counter == 0

    43	class BattleLatch:
    44	    """`wBattleResult` only means anything just after a battle ends.
    45	
    46	    So latch it on the tick `wIsInBattle` goes nonzero to zero, and never read it on a
    47	    goal-check tick. The previous value (1 wild, 2 trainer, $FF lost) does not matter,
    48	    only the flip to 0. Unset means "no battle has finished", so goal predicates that
    49	    depend on it fail closed.
    50	
    51	    `EndOfBattle` writes the result before it clears `wIsInBattle`, so reading both from
    52	    one snapshot cannot race. The edge is sampled every 8 frames, so a battle that both
    53	    starts and ends inside one gap is missed; v0.1's only latched goal is a multi-turn
    54	    trainer battle, and a wild encounter that short would need the tick rate raised.
    55	    """
    56	
    57	    WIN, LOSE, DRAW = 0x00, 0x01, 0x02
    58	
    59	    def __init__(self):
    60	        self.previous = 0
    61	        self.result: int | None = None
    62	        self.count = 0
    63	
    64	    def update(self, is_in_battle: int, battle_result: int) -> int | None:
    65	        if self.previous != 0 and is_in_battle == 0:
    66	            self.result = battle_result
    67	            self.count += 1
    68	        self.previous = is_in_battle
    69	        return self.result

    72	class Driver:
    73	    """Emulator plus the decoded snapshot, one tick at a time."""
    74	
    75	    def __init__(self, emulator, on_frame=None):

    78	        # time so the recording gets every frame, not one in eight
    79	        self.on_frame = on_frame

    84	        # stepping walks into a wall forever without this: the collision grid is the
    85	        # screen's opinion, and an NPC or a ledge is not in it.
    86	        self.stuck: dict[str, int] = {}
    87	        self.heading: str | None = None  # last direction that actually moved the player
    88	
    89	    def tick(self, frames: int = FRAMES_PER_TICK):

    92	        else:

    94	                self.emu.tick(1)

    97	        before = self.latch.count
    98	        self.latch.update(
    99	            self.emu.memory[S.IS_IN_BATTLE], self.emu.memory[S.BATTLE_RESULT]
   100	        )

   161	def battle_ready(state) -> bool:
   162	    """Whether wBattleMon and wEnemyMon hold a battle yet.
   163	
   164	    Both are zeroed through the encounter intro, and every menu byte lies about it, so a
   165	    branch taken on the flag alone asks about a level 0 MON_00 with no moves.
   166	    """
   167	    active, opponent = state.battle.active, state.battle.opponent
   168	    return bool(active and opponent and active.level and opponent.level)

   171	def classify(driver: Driver, goal, waypoint) -> tuple[str, object]:
   172	    """Code decides what kind of tick this is. Only two answers reach Jev.
   173	
   174	    Returns (action, payload): ("wait", None), ("press", button), or ("branch", Branch).
   175	    """
   176	    st = driver.state
   177	    if st.in_battle:
   178	        if not battle_ready(st):
   179	            # "BLUE wants to fight!" is on screen and wBattleMon is still zeroed. The
   180	            # menu bytes cannot say so: wMaxMenuItem keeps the name list's 3 forever and
   181	            # wFontLoaded is overworld-only, so battle text leaves it at 0. The structs
   182	            # being filled in is the one signal that means the menu is really up.
   183	            return _press(st, "a")
   184	        if st.joy_ignore & (S.PAD_A | S.PAD_CTRL_PAD):
   185	            return "wait", None  # the menu is up but the script still owns the pad
   186	        branch = options.battle_branch(
   187	            st, goal, items=options.bag(driver.emu.memory), turn=driver.turn
   188	        )
   189	        return "branch", branch
   190	    prompt = screen.yes_no_prompt(driver.emu.memory)
   191	    if prompt:
   192	        # a cursor is up and A would just take whatever it is sitting on, which said YES
   193	        # to "give a nickname?" and then mashed the keyboard into AAAAAAAAAAAA
   194	        return "branch", options.dialogue_branch(st, goal, prompt[0], prompt[1])
   195	    if st.font_loaded:
   196	        # a text box with no cursor: A costs nothing. wFontLoaded, not wTextBoxID: the
   197	        # latter holds the id of the last box drawn and never clears, so on a cartridge
   198	        # it reads 1 from the intro onward and the agent presses A forever
   199	        return _press(st, "a")
   200	    step = route.next_step(st, waypoint)
   201	    if step and not driver.blocked(step):
   202	        return _press(st, step)
   203	    if waypoint and step is None and driver.heading:
   204	        # standing on the waypoint. Stairs warp the moment they are stepped on, but a
   205	        # house door leaves the player on the mat and wants one more step through it,
   206	        # which is the direction that got us here.
   207	        return _press(st, driver.heading)
   208	    if step and route.distance(st, waypoint) == 1:
   209	        # the waypoint is the next tile and it will not be walked onto: it is an object,
   210	        # Oak or a poke ball. Walking into it already turned the player to face it.
   211	        return _press(st, "a")
   212	    free = [
   213	        d
   214	        for d in route.sidesteps(st, driver.collision(), waypoint)
   215	        if not driver.blocked(d)
   216	    ]
   217	    if len(free) == 1:
   218	        return _press(st, free[0])
   219	    if len(free) > 1:
   220	        return "branch", options.tie_branch(st, goal, waypoint, free)
   221	    return _press(st, "a")

   225	    return ("press", button) if input_ready(state, button) else ("wait", None)

   228	def play(
   229	    emulator,
   230	    policy: Policy,
   231	    max_decisions: int,
   232	    log_path: Path | None = None,
   233	    on_decision=None,
   234	    max_ticks: int = 200_000,
   235	    on_frame=None,
   236	) -> list[dict]:
   237	    """Run until the goal stack empties or `max_decisions` Jev calls have happened."""
   238	    driver = Driver(emulator, on_frame=on_frame)
   239	    stack = goals.GoalStack()
   240	    records: list[dict] = []
   241	    log = log_path.open("a") if log_path else None
   242	    stale, on_goal, where = 0, None, None
   243	    try:
   244	        for _ in range(max_ticks):
   245	            if len(records) >= max_decisions or stack.done:
   246	                break
   247	            driver.tick()
   248	            stack.advance(driver.state, driver.latch)
   249	            goal = stack.current
   250	            if goal is None:
   251	                break
   252	            here = _progress(driver)
   253	            if goal is not on_goal or here != where:
   254	                stale = 0
   255	            on_goal, where = goal, here
   256	            waypoint = route.waypoint_for(goal, driver.state)
   257	            action, payload = classify(driver, goal, waypoint)
   258	            if action == "wait":
   259	                continue
   260	            if action == "press":
   261	                driver.press(payload)
   262	                continue
   263	            forced = stale >= NO_PROGRESS_CAP
   264	            decision = policy.decide(payload, forced=forced)
   265	            if payload.kind == "battle":
   266	                driver.turn += 1
   267	            # the row's HP is the HP the decision was taken on, not what the buttons then
   268	            # did to it: `measure` labels turn n from the HP row n+1 carries
   269	            asked_on = driver.state
   270	            for button in options.buttons_for(driver.state, payload, decision.option):
   271	                driver.press(button)
   272	            if payload.kind == "battle":
   273	                settle_turn(driver)
   274	            record = _record(goal, payload, decision, driver, asked_on)
   275	            records.append(record)
   276	            if log:
   277	                log.write(json.dumps(record) + "\n")
   278	                log.flush()
   279	            if on_decision:
   280	                on_decision(record)
   281	            stale += 1
   282	    finally:
   283	        if log:
   284	            log.close()
   285	    return records

   288	def _battle_signature(state) -> tuple:
   289	    active, opponent = state.battle.active, state.battle.opponent
   290	    return (
   291	        state.in_battle,
   292	        active.hp if active else None,
   293	        opponent.hp if opponent else None,
   294	        state.active_slot,
   295	    )

   298	def settle_turn(driver: Driver):
   299	    """Advance until the chosen move has actually resolved.
   300	
   301	    The battle menu is back up long before the turn is over, and every byte that could
   302	    say otherwise is stale, so without this the same unchanged turn is asked again on the
   303	    next tick: one rival battle billed 139 decisions, eight of them identical at full HP.
   304	    """
   305	    before = _battle_signature(driver.state)
   306	    for _ in range(TURN_SETTLE_TICKS):
   307	        driver.tick()
   308	        if _battle_signature(driver.state) != before:
   309	            return
   310	        if input_ready(driver.state, "a"):
   311	            driver.press("a")  # damage text, level ups, whatever is between turns
   312	
   313	
   314	def _progress(driver: Driver) -> tuple:
   315	    """What "getting somewhere" means, for the no-progress cap.
   316	
   317	    A tile, a finished battle, or a dent in the opponent. A long battle that is being won
   318	    is not stuck, and the cap should not fire on it.
   319	    """
   320	    st = driver.state
   321	    foe = st.battle.opponent
   322	    return (st.map_id, st.x, st.y, driver.latch.count, foe.hp if foe else None)
   323	
   324	
   325	def _record(goal, branch: Branch, decision: Decision, driver: Driver, st) -> dict:
   326	    return {
   327	        "t": time.time(),
   328	        "goal": goal.name,
   329	        "battle_index": driver.latch.count,
   330	        "kind": branch.kind,
   331	        "state": branch.state,
   332	        "options": branch.options,
   333	        "choice": decision.option,
   334	        "probabilities": decision.probabilities,
   335	        "nouls": decision.nouls,
   336	        "fell_back": decision.fell_back,
   337	        "latency_ms": decision.latency_ms,
   338	        "input_tokens": decision.input_tokens,
   339	        "active_hp_fraction": st.battle.active.hp_fraction
   340	        if st.battle.active
   341	        else None,
   342	        # the party slot that was judged. A fainted mon never gets another decision of
   343	        # its own, so the faint shows up as the next decision being a different slot.
   344	        "active_slot": st.active_slot if st.battle.active else None,
   345	    }

The key missing layers beyond the original model are goals/route control, input readiness, screen/menu detection, legal-action construction, fallback/error handling, battle turn settlement, and decision logging/replay.
